description: The main window's permissions: core:default, plus dialog:allow-open for M1.3's directory picker, updater:default for the settings section's update check, and clipboard-manager:allow-write-text for M5.2's copy — the one native integration the page reaches directly, so removing this permission is what makes a refused copy visible. The opener and the notification are driven from Rust and need no page permission; the window-state plugin saves and restores Rust-side, so it needs none either.
